notes: Local governance add-ons for language blocking / claim-elevation gating.
This file is a governance registry artifact; enforcement depends on the active gate implementation.

rules.action: Block C6, formally_proven, closed, universal, and unqualified mechanism-independent language.

rules.condition: simulation_result.tool_rigor_status != RIGOR_ENDORSED && requested_action in [promotion, endorsement, theorem_advancement, dependency_propagation, framework_validation]
rules.action: Demote result to PROVISIONAL_PENDING_RIGOR, cap claims at C1_DEFINED_PROVISIONAL, require mandatory provisional labeling, and block promotion until tool review, implementation audit, metric audit, reproducibility audit, and governance approval are complete.
